description:
Make the switch from crib to big-kid bed gentle and safe with the Toddler Conversion Rail from Old Time Oak. Designed specifically for OTO French Country cribs, this rail replaces the front of the crib to create a secure toddler bed your little one will love.
Crafted from solid wood to match your French Country furniture, the toddler rail is easy to install with all hardware included. The open design allows your child to climb in and out independently while keeping them safely contained during sleep. It is the perfect first step in the 4-in-1 conversion journey, giving your toddler a sense of independence without sacrificing safety.
The rail seamlessly integrates with your existing crib, maintaining the beautiful aesthetic of your nursery. When your child is ready for the next stage, simply add the full bed rail kit for a full-size bed. Non-toxic, baby-safe finish.
